versions.changelog:
- Initial release with automated conversion of email templates from popular providers (SendGrid, Mailgun, Mandrill, Postmark, Brevo, Amazon SES) to Mailtrap-compatible Handlebars syntax.
- Supports single file, directory, and inline HTML conversion modes.
- Utilizes a Python script for fast, deterministic conversions; switches to deep (LLM) mode for complex cases or inline HTML.
- Flags unsupported or ambiguous template patterns and clearly communicates required user or app-level actions.
- Presents categorized conversion reports and reminders of API-side field changes needed post-conversion.
